title: 奥弗布鲁克新发行资格筛选
instruction:
您是 Overbrook Alliance 的高级新股销售支持代理，Saoirse Whitcombe 需要您将现在逐个账户处理的 IPO 资格筛选转变为运营助理无需致电专家即可运行的操作。我们今年开始接收银团分配，秋季日历会更重，并且当前的流程不可重复：部分受限的联名账户、联合车辆、过时的认证和迟到的响应都以不同的方式处理。 Foxhollow Mutual 是可能暴露这些差距的机构关系之一，因为它的一些投资工具通过其他基金进行投资。目标读者是第一周支持新发行的运营助理，熟悉普通账户记录，但不熟悉 FINRA 的新发行限制。准备两个文件：`new_issue_eligibility_procedure.docx`和`new_issue_screening_forms.docx`。使用这些文件名将这两个文件写入工作目录的顶层。程序不得超过五页，表格包不得超过三页。保持美国 FINRA 新发行和旋转限制以及 Overbrook Alliance 对确认分配的控制的资格范围；请勿将其转化为适用性、AML、KYC、销售实践或产品审核指南。
我需要该包执行以下操作：(1) 向运营部门提供从收到分配请求到记录的合格、不合格或待处理结果（包括支持结果的证据和批准）的一条有序路线； (2) 使账户级别筛选适用于个人、联名账户、实体、投资基金和基金结构，而不是假设注册账户名称可以回答问题； (3) 明确处理所有权权益、受限或涵盖人员、相关公司关系、豁免、认证、情况变化以及收到的信息不完整或矛盾的情况； (4) 区分在确认分配之前运营必须具备的条件和谨慎的后续行动，但其本身不会产生自动停止，因为我们最后的控制草案将每一次理想的检查都视为强制拒绝； (5) 解决了参考单一百分比测试的案头习惯，就好像它解决了每个新问题一样，尽管这种捷径并不适用于我们执行的所有筛选； (6) 包括一个可用的晚间分支，用于在下午4:40 到达的分配。
当辛迪加服务台于下午5:00 关闭时，客户或关系所有者尚未答复，并且不允许临时资格确认——运营不得发明结果，但程序也不得暗示每一个未答复的请求都是客户永久拒绝； (7) 提供接收和审查表格，以捕获足够的信息来运行程序、记录理由、记录升级和处置，并支持后续的监督审查。这些表格应适合由关系所有者、授权客户代表和运营审核员（如果他们的职责不同）填写。无论出现这些问题，程序和表格都必须使用相同的资格状态、定义、认证期限、百分比阈值和升级语言。使文件简洁明了，足以在实时分配期间使用，并明确说明谁在行动、哪些证据是可接受的以及无法完成检查时会发生什么。请勿包含系统点击路径、法律建议免责声明、客户营销语言或虚构的服务级别承诺、豁免阈值或桌面权限。我们需要一种操作控制及其工作形式，而不是规则手册的复制。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `new_issue_eligibility_procedure.docx` — 一个简洁、有序的程序，新的运营助理可以在确认新发行分配之前使用它来筛选帐户。 （最多五页；仅限于 FINRA 新发行资格、旋转筛选和相关的分配确认控制；必须无需系统特定说明即可使用。）
- `new_issue_screening_forms.docx` — 可填写的摄入和审核表格包，支持个人、联合、实体、集合和基金中基金账户的程序。 （最多三页；字段、选择、定义、阈值、认证期、结果和升级术语必须与程序一致。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.text:
New-Issue Eligibility Screening Procedure
OVERBROOK ALLIANCE  |  OPERATIONS CONTROL  |  Owner: New-Issues Operations
Purpose and scope
Use this system-neutral control before Overbrook Alliance confirms a U.S. new-issue allocation. It covers FINRA Rules 5130 (restricted persons) and 5131 (spinning), ownership and representations, and the allocation-confirmation decision. It does not replace suitability, AML/KYC, sales-practice, or offering-review work.
Roles and states
Role / state
Operating meaning
Relationship Owner (RO)
Obtains customer facts and routes the completed intake; does not self-approve.
Authorized customer representative
Provides the representation, authority, ownership schedule and change notice.
Operations reviewer
Tests evidence, performs both rules, records rationale and time, and communicates the result.
Supervisor / Compliance
Reviews exemptions, contradictions, unusual structures or unresolved rule questions; no Operations waiver.
Eligible
Required checks complete and supportable. Allocation may be confirmed by the authorized desk.
Ineligible
A substantive restriction or failed requirement is established. Do not confirm; communicate the basis through RO/desk.
Pending
A required fact is missing or conflicting. Do not confirm; assign follow-up and next action. Pending is not a rejection.
Required before confirmation
Operations must have a current representation (obtained within the preceding 12 months, measured from certification date to contemplated allocation/sale date), enough ownership information to calculate applicable interests, and resolved known contrary facts. A proactive refresh request is good practice but, when no contrary fact exists, its absence is not an automatic rejection. Customers/authorized representatives must notify Overbrook of material changes; a dated certification cannot be relied on when Overbrook has reason to believe it is inaccurate.
Ordered route
1  Intake and identify
RO logs request time, issue/issuer, allocation amount or shares, account number/reference, account holder/entity, account type (individual, joint, entity, fund, pooled or fund-of-funds), and contemplated allocation date. Attach the customer/RO intake.
2  Obtain representation
Confirm provider name, role/authority, signature or attestation and date. Check 12-month age. If expired, absent, or known facts conflict, set Pending and request a fresh or corrected representation; do not infer zero restricted ownership.
3  Map beneficial interests
Title is not enough. List each direct or indirect beneficial owner/class and percentage; aggregate restricted interests. For joint accounts, use actual shares of each owner. For entities and pooled/fund-of-funds, obtain look-through data or a reliable authorized representation describing the basis and unresolved data.
4  Rule 5130 screen
Ask about broker-dealer personnel, finders, fiduciaries, portfolio managers, and applicable immediate-family relationships. Family status is conditional: assess the covered person’s role and support, sharing, material benefit, or household circumstances. Record any specified account/entity exemption and factual support—never rely on “institutional” as a shortcut. The de minimis exemption applies only when restricted persons collectively hold no more than 10% of beneficial interests. Above 10%, or unsupported/missing data, is not cleared by this exemption.
5  Rule 5131 spinning screen
Run separately even if Rule 5130 is clear. Identify executive officers/directors of public companies and covered non-public companies, their company affiliation, beneficial-interest percentage, and current, prospective, or recent investment-banking relationship relevant to the allocation. The account-level de minimis threshold is no more than 25% aggregate beneficial interests of covered persons, but the relationship facts must also support the conclusion; 25% alone never settles spinning.
6  Resolve and escalate
Contradictory answers, unusual indirect structures, uncertain category/exemption, or facts that cannot be verified go to Supervisor/Compliance with account and issue identifiers, ownership schedule, certification, documents reviewed, conflict and question. Operations cannot waive a prohibition.
7  Record disposition
Select exactly Eligible, Ineligible, or Pending. Record rule basis, exemption (if any), threshold calculations, evidence, reviewer, date/time and communications. Eligible permits confirmation; Ineligible blocks it; Pending blocks it until resolved.
8  Communicate and retain
Operations tells RO/authorized desk the state and next action; ineligible communications state the basis without implying a waiver. Retain/link intake, representation, schedules, evidence, escalation and final allocation disposition with the account/allocation record so a supervisor can reconstruct who decided what, when, and why.


Screening guidance by structure
Structure
What Operations must establish
If not established
Individual
Holder identity, restricted/covered status, ownership (100%), representation and dates.
Pending; obtain/resolve facts.
Joint
Each owner’s beneficial percentage and status; aggregate restricted and covered interests; document any valid exemption.
Pending—not automatic approval or rejection from one owner.
Entity
Underlying beneficial owners/classes, percentages and role categories; exact exemption basis if applicable.
Pending or Ineligible depending on known facts; never title-only.
Pooled vehicle
Vehicle structure, direct/indirect interests, authorized preparer and reliable look-through representation.
Pending; missing data is not 0%.
Fund-of-funds
Underlying funds/owners or defensible authorized representation, with scope and date.
Pending; escalate if representation is contradictory or unreliable.
Evidence standard
Accept dated customer/authorized-representative certifications, ownership schedules, governing or offering records, and documented internal records that identify source and date. Record what was reviewed, not just “checked.” When relying on an exemption, name the exact exemption and facts. Do not create a side agreement to earmark allocation economics away from a restricted owner; only a valid documented account structure and eligibility basis count.
Mandatory vs prudent
Must: current representation within 12 months; sufficient ownership/indirect-interest basis; separate 5130 and 5131 determinations; resolution of known contrary facts; evidence, reviewer and timestamp; no confirmation for Pending/Ineligible. Should: send proactive event-update reminders and refresh outreach before the 12-month edge when no contrary information exists. A “should” follow-up may improve control but does not itself create automatic ineligibility.
Late-day branch — 4:40 p.m. request / 5:00 p.m. close
If the syndicate desk sends a request at 4:40 p.m., the customer/RO has not answered, and no provisional eligibility confirmation is permitted: (a) log request time and unresolved fact(s); (b) make and time-stamp follow-up attempt(s); (c) set Pending; (d) promptly alert the syndicate desk and Operations supervisor with the record; (e) do not confirm before 5:00 p.m. The authorized desk may hold, reallocate, let the opportunity lapse, or reconsider later under a fresh review. Record desk disposition, escalation recipient/time and final status. No answer by the deadline is not, by itself, permanent customer Ineligible.
Quick decision table
Question
Eligible
Ineligible
Pending
Required evidence/current representation?
Yes, within 12 months and reliable
Known false/failed or substantive restriction
Absent, expired, conflicting or unresolved
Rule 5130
No restriction, or documented exemption (restricted total ≤10%)
Restriction/exemption failure established
Ownership/category cannot be established
Rule 5131
Covered-person/relationship facts support clearance (covered total ≤25% where applicable)
Spinning restriction established
Relationship or ownership facts unresolved
Allocation confirmation
May confirm
Must not confirm
Must not confirm; follow up and reassess
Control note: the 10% Rule 5130 test is not a universal new-issue test. A separate Rule 5131 analysis is always required where applicable.
Document owner: New-Issues Operations  |  Version: 1.0  |  Review trail: retain with allocation record

criteria.description: 两个必需的 DOCX 文件都存在于顶层，位于确切请求的文件名下，并作为有效的 Word 文档成功打开。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作目录和两个 DOCX 文件的内部结构。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认准确的区分大小写的文件名、成功的 DOCX 解析以及不存在目录嵌套。

original.criterion: Both required DOCX files exist at the top level under the exact requested filenames and open successfully as valid Word documents.
original.evidence: The submitted working directory and the internal structure of both DOCX files.
original.grader_hint: Confirm exact case-sensitive filenames, successful DOCX parsing, and absence of directory nesting.

criteria.description: 渲染的程序不超过五页。
criteria.evidence: 渲染`new_issue_eligibility_procedure.docx`。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公引擎进行渲染并计算非空白页数。

original.criterion: The rendered procedure is no more than five pages.
original.grader_hint: Render with a standard office engine and count nonblank pages.

criteria.description: 呈现的表格包不超过三页。
criteria.evidence: 渲染`new_issue_screening_forms.docx`。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公引擎进行渲染并计算非空白页数。

original.criterion: The rendered forms packet is no more than three pages.
original.grader_hint: Render with a standard office engine and count nonblank pages.

criteria.description: 该流程面向入职第一周的运营助理编写，应解释不熟悉的术语或提供足够的操作指引，使读者无需询问作者就能完成资格筛查。
criteria.evidence: 过程语言、定义、指令和决策分支。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估熟悉普通账户记录但对 IPO 筛选不熟悉的运营读者是否可以独立执行控制。

original.criterion: The procedure is written for a first-week Operations associate and defines unfamiliar terms or embeds enough guidance that the reader need not ask the author how to perform the screen.
original.evidence: Procedure language, definitions, instructions, and decision branches.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether an Operations reader familiar with ordinary account records but new to IPO screening could execute the control independently.

criteria.description: 该方案仍保留在新发行资格、旋转筛选和分配确认控制范围内，而没有扩展到适用性、AML、KYC、发行尽职调查或一般销售实践程序。
criteria.evidence: 两份文件的范围陈述和实质性内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 可以接受查找帐户记录所需的附带参考；排除主题的单独筛选工作流程则不然。

original.criterion: The package remains within new-issue eligibility, spinning screening, and allocation confirmation controls without expanding into suitability, AML, KYC, offering diligence, or general sales-practice procedures.
original.evidence: Scope statements and substantive content of both documents.
original.grader_hint: Incidental references needed to locate account records are acceptable; separate screening workflows for excluded topics are not.

criteria.description: 该程序禁止在所需的资格检查产生合格结果之前确认分配，同时将待定状态保留为非最终状态，而不是将其视为合格。
criteria.evidence: 工作流程、决策表、结果定义和后期分支。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪是否有任何路径允许确认，而所需信息仍未解决。

original.criterion: The procedure prohibits confirming an allocation until the required eligibility checks have produced an eligible result, while preserving pending as a nonfinal state rather than treating it as eligible.
original.evidence: Workflow, decision table, outcome definitions, and late-day branch.
original.grader_hint: Trace whether any path permits confirmation while required information remains unresolved.

criteria.description: 该程序提供了从请求接收到证据收集、筛选、处置、沟通和记录完成的清晰操作顺序。
criteria.evidence: 完整的程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 该序列可以是编号的、表格的或基于流的，但依赖性和停止点必须是明确的。

original.criterion: The procedure presents a clear operational sequence from request intake through evidence gathering, screening, disposition, communication, and record completion.
original.grader_hint: The sequence may be numbered, tabular, or flow-based, but dependencies and stopping points must be unambiguous.

criteria.description: 该程序为接收、客户或关系所有者跟进、运营审查、升级和最终分配确认分配可识别的责任。
criteria.evidence: 过程中的角色描述和操作步骤。
criteria.grader_hint: 通用功能角色是可以接受的；不需要个人姓名。

original.criterion: The procedure assigns identifiable responsibility for intake, customer or relationship-owner follow-up, Operations review, escalation, and final allocation confirmation.
original.evidence: Role descriptions and action steps in the procedure.
original.grader_hint: Generic functional roles are acceptable; personal names are not required.

criteria.description: 筛选首先要可靠地识别账户、账户持有人或实体、账户类型以及具体分配请求或正在考虑的新问题。
criteria.evidence: 程序摄入步骤和相应的表单字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查完整的记录是否可以与帐户和分配事件相关联。

original.criterion: Screening begins with reliable identification of the account, account holder or entity, account type, and the specific allocation request or new issue being considered.
original.evidence: Procedure intake step and corresponding form fields.
original.grader_hint: Check that a completed record can be tied to both an account and an allocation event.

criteria.description: 该程序需要评估受益所有权，而不是仅凭注册账户名称来确定资格。
criteria.evidence: 账户和实体的所有权筛选说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求明确的实益利益调查和相关间接利益的处理。

original.criterion: The procedure requires assessment of beneficial ownership rather than allowing the registered account title alone to determine eligibility.
original.evidence: Ownership-screening instructions for accounts and entities.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit beneficial-interest inquiry and treatment of indirect interests where relevant.

criteria.description: 该包通过总计或聚合机制捕获每个相关受益所有人的身份或类别、所有权百分比以及限制或覆盖状态。
criteria.evidence: 表格包和所有权计算说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 结构化所有权计划或等效的可重复机制满足该项目。

original.criterion: The package captures each relevant beneficial owner's identity or class, ownership percentage, and restricted or covered status, with totals or an aggregation mechanism.
original.grader_hint: A structured ownership schedule or equivalent repeatable mechanism satisfies the item.

criteria.description: 该摄入量确定了提供信息的人、该人的能力或权限以及相关签名或证明日期。
criteria.evidence: 客户或关系所有者认证领域。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查姓名、角色或权限、签名/证明和日期，而不是空的复选框。

original.criterion: The intake identifies the person providing the information, that person's capacity or authority, and the relevant signature or attestation date.
original.grader_hint: Check for name, role or authority, signature/attestation, and date rather than a bare checkbox.

criteria.description: 规则5130屏幕涵盖了与业务接收相关的主要限制人员类别，包括经纪自营商人员、发现者和受托人、投资组合经理以及适用的直系亲属关系。
criteria.evidence: 程序定义或筛选问题和表格。
criteria.grader_hint: 等效的简单语言分组是可以接受的；类别必须足够广泛，不能缩小筛选范围，仅用于经纪人员工。

original.criterion: The Rule 5130 screen covers the principal restricted-person categories relevant to operational intake, including broker-dealer personnel, finders and fiduciaries, portfolio managers, and applicable immediate-family relationships.
original.evidence: Procedure definitions or screening questions and forms.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent plain-language grouping is acceptable; the categories must be broad enough not to reduce the screen to broker employees alone.

criteria.description: 直系亲属地位是有条件的，而不是仅仅因为存在家庭关系就自动受到限制。
criteria.evidence: 直系亲属问题、定义和决策说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 考虑受保人的角色以及与限制相关的支持、分享、物质利益或家庭情况。

original.criterion: Immediate-family status is treated conditionally rather than as an automatic restriction merely because a family relationship exists.
original.evidence: Immediate-family questions, definitions, and decision instructions.
original.grader_hint: Look for consideration of the covered person's role and the support, sharing, material-benefit, or household circumstances relevant to the restriction.

criteria.description: 该程序认识到特定账户或实体豁免可能适用，并要求记录确切的豁免和支持依据，而不是从广泛的实体标签中推断。
criteria.evidence: 豁免分支、证据要求和审核者记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件不需要重现每个豁免类别，但它必须防止无证的“机构账户”快捷方式。

original.criterion: The procedure recognizes that specified account or entity exemptions may apply and requires the exact exemption and supporting basis to be documented rather than inferred from a broad entity label.
original.evidence: Exemption branch, evidence requirements, and reviewer record.
original.grader_hint: The document need not reproduce every exempt category, but it must prevent an undocumented 'institutional account' shortcut.

criteria.description: 该程序规定，仅当受限制人员总共持有不超过 10% 账户受益权益时，5130 最低限度豁免规则才适用。
criteria.evidence: 规则5130阈值说明及计算说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受数学上等效的措辞。规定的阈值容差是±0百分点：它必须恰好是10%，并传达聚合和“不超过”边界。

original.criterion: The procedure states that the Rule 5130 de minimis exemption is available only when restricted persons collectively hold no more than 10% of the account's beneficial interests.
original.evidence: Rule 5130 threshold statement and calculation instructions.
original.grader_hint: Accept mathematically equivalent wording. The stated threshold tolerance is ±0 percentage points: it must be exactly 10%, with aggregation and the 'no more than' boundary conveyed.

criteria.description: 对于部分受限制的联名账户，处置遵循受限制实益总额计算和任何记录在案的豁免，而不是自动批准或拒绝一个所有者身份的整个账户。
criteria.evidence: 联名账户分支和所有权工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试具有一名受限制和一名非限制联合所有者的书面分支，并验证所有权百分比是否驱动规则5130 分析。

original.criterion: For a partly restricted joint account, the disposition follows the aggregate restricted beneficial-interest calculation and any documented exemption rather than automatically approving or rejecting the entire account from one owner's status.
original.grader_hint: Test the written branch with one restricted and one unrestricted joint owner and verify that ownership percentages drive the Rule 5130 analysis.

criteria.description: 该方案并不意味着在没有有效、有记录的账户结构和资格基础的情况下，分配经济学可能会简单地远离受限制的所有者。
criteria.evidence: 联名账户、所有权和例外语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否有不受支持的利润分配或口头协议解决方法。

original.criterion: The package does not suggest that allocation economics may simply be earmarked away from a restricted owner without a valid, documented account structure and eligibility basis.
original.grader_hint: Check for unsupported profit-allocation or verbal side-agreement workarounds.

criteria.description: 集合工具和基金中的基金账户会收到书面的间接所有权或可靠的代表性分析，而不是仅仅因为直接投资者本身就是基金而被清算。
criteria.evidence: 拼车分支和补充表格问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一种可重复的方法来建立相关的潜在限制和涵盖利益，或建立依赖授权代表的可辩护基础。

original.criterion: Pooled vehicles and fund-of-funds accounts receive a documented indirect-ownership or reliable-representation analysis rather than being cleared solely because the direct investor is itself a fund.
original.evidence: Pooled-vehicle branch and supplemental form questions.
original.grader_hint: Look for a repeatable way to establish relevant underlying restricted and covered interests or a defensible basis for reliance on an authorized representation.

criteria.description: 当无法获得或可靠代表集合账户或基金中基金账户所需的所有权信息时，根据规定的规则，结果仍悬而未决或不合格；不假定其低于最低阈值。
criteria.evidence: 投资工具的缺失信息分支。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证数据的缺失永远不会成为零利率限制假设。

original.criterion: When required ownership information for a pooled or fund-of-funds account cannot be obtained or reliably represented, the result remains pending or ineligible under the stated rule; it is not assumed to be below a de minimis threshold.
original.grader_hint: Verify that absence of data never becomes a zero-percent restricted-interest assumption.

criteria.description: 该程序明确指出，满足规则513010%测试并不能完成筛选，并且需要在适用的情况下进行单独的规则5131纺纱分析。
criteria.evidence: 工作流的规则 5130 和规则 5131 部分之间的转换。
criteria.grader_hint: 这是常见的单百分比快捷方式所需的限制；寻找两个不同的决策，而不是一个混合阈值。

original.criterion: The procedure makes clear that satisfying the Rule 5130 10% test does not finish the screening and requires a separate Rule 5131 spinning analysis where applicable.
original.evidence: Transition between the Rule 5130 and Rule 5131 portions of the workflow.
original.grader_hint: This is the required limit on the common single-percentage shortcut; look for two distinct decisions rather than one blended threshold.

criteria.description: 规则5131的纳入确定了上市公司和涵盖的非上市公司的执行官和董事，或实质上等效的涵盖人员类别。
criteria.evidence: 旋转屏幕问题和定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果能够识别相关的高级公司角色并涵盖公司类型，则可以接受简单的语言描述。

original.criterion: The Rule 5131 intake identifies executive officers and directors of public companies and covered non-public companies, or materially equivalent covered-person categories.
original.grader_hint: Plain-language descriptions are acceptable if they identify the relevant senior corporate roles and covered company types.

criteria.description: 旋转屏幕捕获了所涉及人员的公司隶属关系以及评估分配所需的当前、未来或最近的适用投资银行关系。
criteria.evidence: 表单中的程序和公司关系字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅询问某人是否是高管的一般性问题是不够的。

original.criterion: The spinning screen captures the covered person's company affiliation and the applicable current, prospective, or recent investment-banking relationship needed to evaluate the allocation.
original.evidence: Procedure and company-relationship fields in the forms.
original.grader_hint: A generic question asking only whether someone is an executive is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该程序规定，规则5131账户级别最低阈值不超过25%受保人的受益权益总额。
criteria.evidence: 旋转阈值和计算说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 容差为±0百分点：文档必须准确说明25%，并传达聚合和包含边界。

original.criterion: The procedure states the Rule 5131 account-level de minimis threshold as no more than 25% aggregate beneficial interests of covered persons.
original.grader_hint: The tolerance is ±0 percentage points: the document must state exactly 25%, with aggregation and the inclusive boundary conveyed.

criteria.description: 规则5131的处置反映了相关人员的所有权和相关公司关系，而不是将25%计算视为唯一的旋转问题。
criteria.evidence: 旋转工作流程和审稿人确定。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪逻辑并确认如果没有关系事实，仅凭百分比无法解析屏幕。

original.criterion: The Rule 5131 disposition reflects both covered-person ownership and the relevant company relationship rather than treating the 25% calculation as the only spinning question.
original.grader_hint: Trace the logic and confirm that a percentage alone cannot resolve the screen without the relationship facts.

criteria.description: 该套餐规定，用于新发行资格的账户代表必须在之前的12个月内获得。
criteria.evidence: 程序中的认证有效性规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 容差为±0个月：规定的有效期必须恰好为12个月，并且在分配或出售之前必须与信赖挂钩。

original.criterion: The package states that an account representation used for new-issue eligibility must have been obtained within the preceding 12 months.
original.grader_hint: The tolerance is ±0 months: the stated validity period must be exactly 12 months and must be tied to reliance before the allocation or sale.

criteria.description: 该程序告诉运营部门如何使用认证日期和预期分配日期来确定和记录认证是否仍在12月期间内。
criteria.evidence: 日期检查说明和审阅者字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件无需规定特定的日期公式，但操作比较和记录日期必须明确。

original.criterion: The procedure tells Operations how to determine and record whether a certification is still within the 12-month period using the certification date and the contemplated allocation date.
original.grader_hint: The document need not prescribe a particular date formula, but the operative comparison and recorded dates must be clear.

criteria.description: 当奥弗布鲁克联盟有理由相信其不准确或事实发生重大变化时，不能依赖仍然过时的认证。
criteria.evidence: 环境变化和矛盾信息分支。
criteria.grader_hint: 当已知相反信息时，寻求强制停止或刷新；仅仅进行年龄测试是不够的。

original.criterion: A still-dated certification cannot be relied upon when Overbrook Alliance has reason to believe it is inaccurate or facts have materially changed.
original.grader_hint: Look for a mandatory stop or refresh when contrary information is known; mere age testing is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该程序绘制了一个可用的必须/应该边界：所需的当前表示和已知相反事实的解决是硬控制，而未显示任何变化的明智的主动更新请求不会被错误地标记为独立监管拒绝条件。
criteria.evidence: 强制性语言、最佳实践语言和处置逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查“必须”和“应该”是否具有操作后果，并且不允许可选的后续行动推翻其他可支持的决定。

original.criterion: The procedure draws a usable must/should boundary: required current representations and resolution of known contrary facts are hard controls, while sensible proactive update requests that reveal no change are not mislabeled as independent regulatory rejection conditions.
original.evidence: Mandatory language, best-practice language, and disposition logic.
original.grader_hint: Check that 'must' and 'should' have operational consequences and that optional follow-up is not allowed to override an otherwise supportable determination.

criteria.description: 该方案要求客户或授权代表将重大资格变更通知奥弗布鲁克联盟，而不仅仅是依靠日历更新。
criteria.evidence: 认证语言和程序后续期望。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找肯定的变更通知承诺或指示。

original.criterion: The package requires customers or authorized representatives to notify Overbrook Alliance of material eligibility changes rather than relying only on calendar renewal.
original.evidence: Certification language and procedure follow-up expectations.
original.grader_hint: Look for an affirmative change-notification commitment or instruction.

criteria.description: 三种操作状态（合格、不合格和待定）被明确定义，并且每个状态都会导致明确的分配确认结果。
criteria.evidence: 结果定义、工作流程和表格。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证这些状态是否可以相互理解，并且待处理未用作拒绝或批准的同义词。

original.criterion: The three operational states—eligible, ineligible, and pending—are distinctly defined, and each state leads to a clear allocation-confirmation consequence.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the states are mutually intelligible and that pending is not used as a synonym for rejected or approved.

criteria.description: 合格判定记录规则依据、豁免（如果有）、阈值计算（如果使用）、审查的证据、审查者和判定时间。
criteria.evidence: 表格和程序文件要求的审阅者部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 并非每种情况下都必须填充每个字段，但记录必须支持决策的重建。

original.criterion: An eligible determination records the rule basis, exemption if any, threshold calculation if used, evidence reviewed, reviewer, and determination time.
original.evidence: Reviewer section of the forms and procedure documentation requirements.
original.grader_hint: Not every field must be populated in every case, but the record must support reconstruction of the decision.

criteria.description: 不合格判定会记录取消资格的依据，并提供受控的沟通或升级路线，但这并不意味着运营部门可以放弃该规则。
criteria.evidence: 不合格的分支和处置字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查该过程是否区分解释或升级结果与覆盖结果。

original.criterion: An ineligible determination records the disqualifying basis and provides a controlled communication or escalation route without implying that Operations can waive the rule.
original.grader_hint: Check that the procedure distinguishes explaining or escalating a result from overriding it.

criteria.description: 待决决定确定了缺失或冲突的事实、负责后续行动的人员以及下一个适用的行动。
criteria.evidence: 待处理分支和表单字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 没有原因、所有者和操作的裸露待处理复选框不满足该项目。

original.criterion: A pending determination identifies the missing or conflicting fact, the person responsible for follow-up, and the next applicable action.
original.grader_hint: A bare pending checkbox without reason, owner, and action does not satisfy the item.

criteria.description: 下午4:40该场景有一个可执行分支，该分支将帐户记录为待处理，识别未解决的信息，及时提醒相应的部门或主管，并防止在下午 5:00 之前进行临时确认。关闭。
criteria.evidence: 程序中的后期或截止日期分支。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有四种效果都必须存在； “根据需要升级”的通用语言是不够的。

original.criterion: The 4:40 p.m. scenario has an executable branch that records the account as pending, identifies the unresolved information, promptly alerts the appropriate desk or supervisor, and prevents provisional confirmation before the 5:00 p.m. close.
original.evidence: Late-day or deadline branch in the procedure.
original.grader_hint: All four effects must be present; generic language to 'escalate as needed' is insufficient.

criteria.description: 后期分支机构允许记录保留、重新分配、失效或稍后重新考虑操作可用，而不会仅仅因为在截止日期前未收到答复而将客户标记为永久不合格。
criteria.evidence: 后期处置和后续治疗语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件可以将商业选择留给授权部门，但它必须将特定交易的不完整性与实质性的客户不资格区分开来。

original.criterion: The late-day branch permits a documented hold, reallocation, lapse, or later reconsideration as operationally available without labeling the customer permanently ineligible solely because no answer arrived by the deadline.
original.grader_hint: The document may leave the commercial choice to the authorized desk, but it must separate deal-specific incompleteness from substantive customer ineligibility.

criteria.description: 最新记录捕获请求时间、后续尝试、升级接收者和时间、办公桌处置和最终状态。
criteria.evidence: 表格包和后期程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 等效的可审核字段是可接受的。

original.criterion: The late-day record captures the request time, follow-up attempt or attempts, escalation recipient and time, desk disposition, and final status.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent auditable fields are acceptable.

criteria.description: 任何例外或豁免途径都需要记录事实以及适合该问题的可识别批准或审查；该程序不会产生不成文的操作豁免。
criteria.evidence: 例外、豁免和升级步骤。
criteria.grader_hint: 区分有效规则豁免的应用和酌情放弃禁止的情况。

original.criterion: Any exception or exemption path requires documented facts and an identifiable approval or review appropriate to the issue; the procedure does not create an unwritten Operations waiver.
original.grader_hint: Distinguish application of a valid rule exemption from discretionary waiver of a prohibition.

criteria.description: 不明确、矛盾或不寻常的结构将被转至适当的监督或合规审查，并提供简明的问题记录，而不是通过不受支持的运营判断来解决。
criteria.evidence: 升级标准和升级所需的信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 升级必须说明随附的事实和文件，而不仅仅是说“询问合规部”。

original.criterion: Ambiguous, contradictory, or unusual structures are routed to an appropriate supervisory or compliance review with a concise issue record instead of being resolved by unsupported Operations judgment.
original.evidence: Escalation criteria and information required with an escalation.
original.grader_hint: The escalation must state what facts and documents accompany it, not merely say 'ask Compliance.'

criteria.description: 完成的屏幕将被保留或与帐户和分配记录链接，以便主管可以重建谁决定什么、何时以及根据什么证据。
criteria.evidence: 收尾和记录保存说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 系统中立的归档指令就足够了；预计没有点击路径。

original.criterion: The completed screen is retained or linked with the account and allocation record so a supervisor can reconstruct who decided what, when, and on what evidence.
original.grader_hint: A system-neutral filing instruction is sufficient; no click path is expected.

criteria.description: 表格包清楚地将关系所有者或授权客户代表提供的信息与运营部门完成的分析和处理分开。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的表单数据包。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估标签、分组、签名和工作流程提示；不应邀请用户自行批准资格。

original.criterion: The forms packet clearly separates information supplied by a relationship owner or authorized customer representative from the analysis and disposition completed by Operations.
original.grader_hint: Assess labels, grouping, signatures, and workflow cues; users should not be invited to self-approve eligibility.

criteria.description: 这些表格提供了结构化规则5130认证，涵盖受限人员权益、所有权百分比、适用的豁免基础、变更通知、权限和日期。
criteria.evidence: 表格的客户或帐户接收部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅自由格式笔记是不够的；该表格必须提示列出的每一类信息。

original.criterion: The forms provide a structured Rule 5130 certification covering restricted-person interests, ownership percentages, applicable exemption basis, change notification, authority, and date.
original.evidence: Customer or account-intake portions of the forms.
original.grader_hint: Free-form notes alone are insufficient; the form must prompt for each listed class of information.

criteria.description: 这些表格提供了一个独特的规则5131旋转部分，涵盖涵盖人员的身份或地位、公司隶属关系、受益权益百分比、相关投资银行关系和审核者结论。
criteria.evidence: 形式的纺纱部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 该部分可以共享所有权表，但必须保留单独的规则5131决定。

original.criterion: The forms provide a distinct Rule 5131 spinning section covering covered-person identity or status, company affiliation, beneficial-interest percentage, relevant investment-banking relationship, and reviewer conclusion.
original.grader_hint: The section may share an ownership schedule but must preserve the separate Rule 5131 decision.

criteria.description: 这些表格包括集合工具和母基金的可行补充或提示，包括结构、直接和间接所有权信息或代表基础、编制者权限和未解决的数据状态。
criteria.evidence: 表格包的投资工具部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 Foxhollow Mutual 式的间接投资结构是否实际上可以使用该数据包进行记录。

original.criterion: The forms include a workable supplement or prompts for pooled vehicles and fund-of-funds, including structure, direct and indirect ownership information or representation basis, preparer authority, and unresolved-data status.
original.evidence: Investment-vehicle portions of the forms packet.
original.grader_hint: Check whether Foxhollow Mutual-style indirect investment structures could actually be documented using the packet.

criteria.description: 审核者部分支持合格、不合格和待定的选择，并捕获理由、证据、计算或豁免基础、审核者身份、日期和时间、升级和分配处置。
criteria.evidence: 表格的操作审查和处置区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 这些字段可能很紧凑，但每个列出的决策记录元素必须有一个明确的位置。

original.criterion: The reviewer section supports eligible, ineligible, and pending selections and captures rationale, evidence, calculation or exemption basis, reviewer identity, date and time, escalation, and allocation disposition.
original.evidence: Operations review and disposition area of the forms.
original.grader_hint: The fields may be compact, but each listed decision-record element must have a clear place.

criteria.description: 程序和表格一致认为规则5130最低阈值恰好是10%，包括聚合和边界处理。
criteria.evidence: 两个可交付成果。
criteria.grader_hint: 参考规则5130阈值比较每个出现、指令、标签和计算提示。

original.criterion: The procedure and forms agree that the Rule 5130 de minimis threshold is exactly 10%, including the aggregation and boundary treatment.
original.grader_hint: Compare every occurrence, instruction, label, and calculation cue referring to the Rule 5130 threshold.

criteria.description: 程序和表格一致认为规则5131最低阈值恰好是25%，包括聚合和边界处理。
criteria.evidence: 两个可交付成果。
criteria.grader_hint: 参考规则5131阈值比较每个出现、指令、标签和计算提示。

original.criterion: The procedure and forms agree that the Rule 5131 de minimis threshold is exactly 25%, including the aggregation and boundary treatment.
original.grader_hint: Compare every occurrence, instruction, label, and calculation cue referring to the Rule 5131 threshold.

criteria.description: 程序和表格就12月的代表期限以及三个结果标签及其操作含义达成一致。
criteria.evidence: 两个可交付成果。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查日期语言、结果名称、复选框标签、定义以及矛盾的下游后果。

original.criterion: The procedure and forms agree on the 12-month representation period and on the three outcome labels and their operational meaning.
original.grader_hint: Check date language, outcome names, checkbox labels, definitions, and downstream consequences for contradictions.

criteria.description: 渲染的页面在实时分配期间具有专业的可读性和可用性：层次结构清晰，表单提供足够的书写或选择空间，决策点易于定位，并且没有必要的文本被剪裁或渲染得小得难以阅读。
criteria.evidence: 两个可交付成果的渲染页面。
criteria.grader_hint: 以正常观看尺寸进行目视审查，并考虑在截止日期压力下实际完成。

original.criterion: Rendered pages are professionally legible and usable during a live allocation: hierarchy is clear, forms provide adequate writing or selection space, decision points are easy to locate, and no essential text is clipped or rendered unreadably small.
original.grader_hint: Review visually at normal viewing size and consider practical completion under deadline pressure.

criteria.description: 这些表格不会仅仅为了进行新发放的资格筛选而索取不必要的高风险个人识别信息，例如社会安全号码、护照号码、完整出生日期或身份证件副本。
criteria.evidence: 表格包中的所有请求字段和附件说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果数据包在没有特定筛选必要性的情况下明确要求任何列出的标识符或类似的过多身份证明文件，则适用处罚；普通名称、角色、从属关系、所有权百分比、签名和帐户引用不会触发它。

original.criterion: The forms do not solicit unnecessary high-risk personal identifiers such as Social Security numbers, passport numbers, full dates of birth, or copies of identity documents merely to conduct the new-issue eligibility screen.
original.evidence: All requested fields and attachment instructions in the forms packet.
original.grader_hint: Apply the penalty if the packet affirmatively requests any listed identifier or similarly excessive identity documentation without a screening-specific necessity; ordinary names, roles, affiliations, ownership percentages, signatures, and account references do not trigger it.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: The reference package should be drafted by a U.S. broker-dealer new-issues compliance or operations specialist and independently reviewed by a second specialist familiar with FINRA Rules 5130 and 5131. Reviewers must trace individual, joint, entity, pooled-vehicle, stale-certification, contradictory-information, and late-day pending scenarios through both documents and compare every shared threshold, period, state, and escalation term.
known_limitations: The package is a system-neutral operational control, not firm-specific legal advice. intended_artifacts.procedure: Create an instructional, system-neutral new-issue eligibility procedure for a first-week Operations associate. It must contain an ordered workflow, role ownership, evidence standards, separate Rule 5130 and Rule 5131 determinations, clear disposition states, escalation criteria, and a late-day incomplete-screen branch.
intended_artifacts.forms: Create a compact forms packet with distinct contributor and reviewer responsibilities. It must support ordinary accounts, entities, joint accounts, pooled vehicles, and fund-of-funds; it must capture the facts, calculations, evidence, dates, attestations, outcome, escalation, and allocation disposition required by the procedure.

governing_relationships: No allocation may be confirmed unless required screening is complete and the recorded outcome is eligible. Pending is not approval and ineligible is not waivable by Operations.
The Rule 5130 de minimis test uses the aggregate beneficial interests of restricted persons. The exemption applies at no more than 10%; a result above 10% does not qualify for that exemption.

A partly restricted joint account is analyzed using actual beneficial interests and applicable exemptions. One restricted owner does not automatically decide the entire account without the aggregate analysis, and missing ownership data cannot be treated as zero.

The registered account title does not replace beneficial-ownership analysis. Indirect interests in entities, pooled vehicles, and fund-of-funds must be established through appropriate ownership information or a reliable authorized representation.
Rule 5130 clearance, including satisfaction of its 10% test, does not complete the work. Rule 5131 spinning must be evaluated separately.

The Rule 5131 account-level de minimis threshold is no more than 25% aggregate beneficial interests of covered persons, but the spinning decision also depends on covered status, company affiliation, and the relevant investment-banking relationship.
A representation used for eligibility must have been obtained within the preceding 12 months. The operative comparison is between its date and the contemplated allocation or sale date.

A representation that remains within 12 months cannot be relied upon when known facts create reason to believe it is inaccurate. Known contrary facts require resolution; proactive event-update outreach may be prudent but is not itself an independent rejection rule when no contrary fact exists.

Eligible, ineligible, and pending are the only operational outcomes. Eligible requires supporting evidence and rationale; ineligible requires the substantive basis; pending requires the unresolved fact, owner, and next action.

At 4:40 p.m. with a 5:00 p.m. desk close and no answer, the case remains pending, the missing fact and attempts are recorded, the appropriate desk or supervisor is alerted, and no provisional confirmation occurs. An authorized desk may hold, reallocate, let the opportunity lapse, or reconsider later; lateness alone is not permanent substantive ineligibility.

Exemptions require a documented factual basis. Unusual, contradictory, or indeterminate cases go to supervisory or compliance review with the issue and supporting facts; Operations receives no implied waiver authority.
The procedure and forms must use exactly the same 10% and 25% thresholds, 12-month period, outcome states, and escalation terminology.

designed_tensions.rule_of_thumb_limit: The familiar 10% Rule 5130 de minimis test is not a universal new-issue clearance test. The gold must explicitly continue to a separate Rule 5131 analysis with its own 25% threshold and relationship facts.
designed_tensions.must_should_boundary: Current representations and resolution of known contrary facts are mandatory preconditions. Sensible proactive refresh outreach absent contrary facts is a risk-control practice and must not be transformed into an automatic rejection condition.
designed_tensions.late_day_control: The gold must protect the no-provisional-confirmation rule while distinguishing a deal-specific pending result from permanent customer ineligibility.

original_instruction:
You’re the senior new-issues sales support agent at Overbrook Alliance, and Saoirse Whitcombe needs you to turn the IPO eligibility screening now handled account by account into something an Operations associate can run without calling a specialist. We began receiving syndicate allocations this year, the autumn calendar will be heavier, and the current process is not repeatable: partly restricted joint accounts, pooled vehicles, stale certifications, and late responses are all being handled differently. Foxhollow Mutual is one of the institutional relationships likely to expose those gaps because some of its investment vehicles invest through other funds. The intended reader is an Operations associate on their first week supporting new issues, familiar with ordinary account records but not with FINRA’s new-issue restrictions. Prepare two documents: `new_issue_eligibility_procedure.docx` and `new_issue_screening_forms.docx`. Write both files into the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames. The procedure must be no more than five pages and the forms packet no more than three pages. Keep the scope to eligibility under the U.S. FINRA new-issue and spinning restrictions and Overbrook Alliance’s control around confirming an allocation; do not turn this into suitability, AML, KYC, sales-practice, or offering-review guidance. I need the package to do the following: (1) give Operations one ordered route from receipt of an allocation request through a recorded eligible, ineligible, or pending result, including the evidence and approval that support the result; (2) make the account-level screening workable for individuals, joint accounts, entities, investment funds, and fund-of-funds structures rather than assuming that the registered account title answers the question; (3) deal explicitly with ownership interests, restricted or covered persons, relevant company relationships, exemptions, certifications, changed circumstances, and cases where the information received is incomplete or contradictory; (4) distinguish what Operations must have before an allocation can be confirmed from follow-up that is prudent but does not itself create an automatic stop, because our last control draft treated every desirable check as a mandatory rejection; (5) address the desk habit of referring to a single percentage test as though it settles every new-issue question, even though that shortcut does not hold across all of the screening we perform; (6) include a usable late-day branch for an allocation arriving at 4:40 p.m. when the syndicate desk closes at 5:00 p.m., the customer or relationship owner has not answered, and no provisional eligibility confirmation is permitted—Operations must not invent a result, but the procedure also must not imply that every unanswered request is a permanent customer rejection; and (7) provide intake and review forms that capture enough information to run the procedure, document the rationale, record escalation and disposition, and support later supervisory review. The forms should be suitable for completion by a relationship owner, an authorized customer representative, and the Operations reviewer where their responsibilities differ. The procedure and forms must use the same eligibility states, definitions, certification period, percentage thresholds, and escalation language wherever those matters appear. Make the documents concise, plain enough to use during a live allocation, and explicit about who acts, what evidence is acceptable, and what happens when a check cannot be completed. Do not include system click paths, legal advice disclaimers, customer marketing language, or invented service-level commitments, waiver thresholds, or desk authorities. We need an operational control and its working forms, not a reproduction of the rulebook.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `new_issue_eligibility_procedure.docx` — A concise, ordered procedure that a new Operations associate can use to screen an account before confirming a new-issue allocation. (Maximum five pages; limited to FINRA new-issue eligibility, spinning screening, and the associated allocation-confirmation control; must be usable without system-specific instructions.)
- `new_issue_screening_forms.docx` — A fillable intake and reviewer forms packet supporting the procedure for individual, joint, entity, pooled, and fund-of-funds accounts. (Maximum three pages; fields, choices, definitions, thresholds, certification period, outcomes, and escalation terminology must agree with the procedure.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
